Find a Clinical Psychology Professor by Research Interest

Tools

Find a Professor by Research Interest

Fit matters more than prestige in clinical psychology admissions. Type a topic — trauma, eating disorders, CBT, ADHD, anything — and find PhD faculty who actually study it, straight from their own page.

2681 professors across 242 programs · last updated 2026-10-05

Every interest listed here is quoted or closely paraphrased from that professor's own faculty or lab bio page — never inferred from a publication list, and never taken from search results.

Would rather browse than search? The same faculty are grouped by research topic — trauma, anxiety, eating disorders and fourteen more, each showing the professor's own wording.

Where we've checked that program's own "accepting students" page for this cycle, you'll see it flagged on their card too — accepting, maybe, or not this year. No badge just means we haven't verified that program's list yet, not that the professor isn't accepting.

This is an early, growing directory. It currently covers a pilot set of programs, not the full roster of APA-accredited programs. More are being added over time.
